deck.name: Harry Potter
deck.description: Characters, spells, places and lore from the seven original novels. Contains book spoilers.

questions.prompt: Which school does Harry attend?
questions.explanation: Durmstrang and Beauxbatons are the schools that visit Hogwarts for the Triwizard Tournament in Goblet of Fire.

questions.prompt: Which Hogwarts house does Harry join?
questions.explanation: The Sorting Hat considers Slytherin, but Harry asks not to be put there.

questions.prompt: What are Ravenclaw's house colors in the novels?
questions.explanation: The films commonly use blue and silver, but the books use blue and bronze.

questions.prompt: What animal is Ravenclaw's emblem in the novels?
questions.explanation: The novels give Rowena Ravenclaw's house an eagle, even though the name suggests a raven.

questions.prompt: Which platform does the Hogwarts Express leave from at King's Cross?
questions.explanation: Students reach it by walking straight through the barrier between platforms nine and ten.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Harry's snowy owl?
questions.explanation: Hagrid buys Hedwig for Harry's eleventh birthday at Eeylops Owl Emporium in Diagon Alley.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the wizarding bank in Diagon Alley?
questions.explanation: Goblins run Gringotts, and its vaults lie deep below London.

questions.prompt: Who sells Harry his first wand?
questions.explanation: The sign over the shop says Ollivanders has made fine wands since 382 B.C.

questions.prompt: What is the core of Harry's first wand?
questions.explanation: The feather came from Fawkes, Dumbledore's phoenix. Fawkes gave just one other feather, for Voldemort's wand.

questions.prompt: What wood is Harry's first wand made from?
questions.explanation: The wand is holly and phoenix feather, eleven inches long.

questions.prompt: Who is Hogwarts headmaster during Harry's first year?
questions.explanation: Armando Dippet was headmaster fifty years earlier, when Tom Riddle was a student.

questions.prompt: Who teaches Harry Potions in his first year?
questions.explanation: Horace Slughorn takes over Potions in Harry's sixth year, when Snape moves to Defence Against the Dark Arts.

questions.prompt: Who teaches Defence Against the Dark Arts in Harry's third year?
questions.explanation: Lupin follows Quirrell, who taught in Harry's first year, and Lockhart, who taught in his second.

questions.prompt: Who teaches Transfiguration during Harry's first year?
questions.explanation: McGonagall is also head of Gryffindor House and a registered Animagus who can turn into a cat.

questions.prompt: What kind of magical being is Dobby?
questions.explanation: Dobby serves the Malfoy family until Harry tricks Lucius Malfoy into freeing him with a sock.

questions.prompt: What secret about Remus Lupin is revealed in Prisoner of Azkaban?
questions.explanation: Snape sets an essay on werewolves, and Hermione works out the secret from Lupin's absences at the full moon.

questions.prompt: What animal form does Harry's corporeal Patronus take?
questions.explanation: The stag matches the Animagus form of Harry's father, James, whose nickname was Prongs.

questions.prompt: What animal form does Hermione's Patronus take?
questions.explanation: Ron's Patronus, by contrast, is a Jack Russell terrier.

questions.prompt: Which spell is used to disarm an opponent?
questions.explanation: Expelliarmus becomes Harry's signature spell. He uses it in his final duel with Voldemort.

questions.prompt: Which spell lights the tip of a wand?
questions.explanation: Nox is the counter-spell that puts the light out again.

questions.prompt: Which Quidditch position does Harry play for Gryffindor?
questions.explanation: McGonagall picks Harry as Seeker in his first year, making him the youngest house player in about a century.

questions.prompt: Which ball does a Quidditch Seeker try to catch?
questions.explanation: Catching the Snitch earns 150 points and usually ends the game. The Golden Snidget was the rare bird the Snitch replaced.

questions.prompt: In the original novels, how many points does catching the Golden Snitch score?
questions.explanation: Catching the Snitch also ends the match.

questions.prompt: What creature is hidden in the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: A basilisk's direct gaze kills. Its victims at Hogwarts saw it only indirectly, so they were petrified instead.

questions.prompt: What does a Horcrux contain?
choices: A copy of a person's memories
A reserve of a person's spells
A fragment of a person's soul
A record of a person's dreams
questions.explanation: Voldemort meant to make six Horcruxes. Harry became an extra one that Voldemort never intended.

questions.prompt: Which spell is used against a Boggart?
questions.explanation: A Boggart takes the shape of whatever the viewer fears most. Laughter defeats it.

questions.prompt: Hufflepuff's emblem is a badger.
questions.explanation: Its house colors are yellow and black.

questions.prompt: Polyjuice Potion permanently changes the drinker's appearance.
questions.explanation: Its effects wear off unless another dose is taken.

questions.prompt: What is a Pensieve used for?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore keeps one in his office. Harry sees Snape's memories in it in Deathly Hallows.

questions.prompt: What does the Marauder's Map show?
questions.answer: The layout of Hogwarts and the locations of people moving around it, including many secret passages.
questions.explanation: Moony, Wormtail, Padfoot and Prongs made the map. They were Lupin, Pettigrew, Sirius Black and James Potter.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the Weasley family's home?
questions.explanation: The Burrow is near the village of Ottery St Catchpole. Shell Cottage belongs to Bill and Fleur, and Spinner's End is Snape's home.

questions.prompt: Which house in London serves as headquarters of the Order of the Phoenix?
questions.explanation: 12 Grimmauld Place is the Black family home. Sirius lends it to the Order, and it is hidden by the Fidelius Charm.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Hagrid's three-headed dog?
questions.explanation: Fluffy guards the trapdoor to the Philosopher's Stone. Fang is Hagrid's boarhound, Norbert a dragon, and Buckbeak a hippogriff.

questions.prompt: What does the Mirror of Erised show the person looking into it?
choices: The deepest desire of their heart
The future they are most afraid of
The true face of anyone in disguise
Memories they have tried to forget
questions.explanation: "Erised" is "desire" spelled backwards. Dumbledore warns Harry that people have wasted away in front of the mirror.

questions.prompt: Which Hogwarts house is Luna Lovegood in?
questions.explanation: Luna is in Ravenclaw, the house that values wit and learning.

questions.prompt: Which Quidditch position does Ron play for Gryffindor?
questions.explanation: Ron becomes Keeper in Order of the Phoenix. The Keeper guards the three goal hoops.

questions.prompt: Which Hogsmeade shop sells sweets such as Chocolate Frogs and Fizzing Whizzbees?
questions.explanation: Honeydukes is the sweet shop. A secret passage leads from its cellar to Hogwarts.

questions.prompt: What animal does Professor McGonagall turn into as an Animagus?
questions.explanation: McGonagall is a registered Animagus. Sirius becomes a black dog and Peter Pettigrew a rat, and James Potter became a stag.

questions.prompt: Which three objects make up the Deathly Hallows?
questions.answer: The Elder Wand, the Resurrection Stone and the Cloak of Invisibility.
questions.explanation: The Tale of the Three Brothers says Death gave the objects to the Peverell brothers.

questions.prompt: Who kills Albus Dumbledore at the top of the Astronomy Tower?
questions.explanation: Draco was ordered to kill Dumbledore, but Snape casts the curse. Dumbledore had planned this beforehand.

questions.prompt: What does the spell Accio do?
choices: Unlocks a locked door or window
Makes an object float in the air
Summons an object to the caster
questions.explanation: Accio is the Summoning Charm. Harry uses it to call his Firebolt during the first task of the Triwizard Tournament.

questions.prompt: Sirius Black is Harry Potter's godfather.
questions.explanation: James Potter chose his best friend Sirius to be Harry's godfather.

questions.prompt: Neville Longbottom kills Nagini with the Sword of Gryffindor.
questions.explanation: In Deathly Hallows, Neville pulls the sword from the Sorting Hat and destroys Nagini, the last Horcrux before Voldemort himself.

questions.prompt: Which house-elf serves the Black family?
questions.explanation: Dobby served the Malfoys, Winky served the Crouches, and Hokey served Hepzibah Smith.

questions.prompt: In which village did Lily and James Potter live when Voldemort attacked them?
questions.explanation: Godric's Hollow is named after Godric Gryffindor. Little Hangleton is where the Riddle family lived.

questions.prompt: Which three schools compete in the Triwizard Tournament in Goblet of Fire?
questions.explanation: Fleur Delacour represents Beauxbatons and Viktor Krum represents Durmstrang. Cedric Diggory and Harry both represent Hogwarts.

questions.prompt: Which potion, known as liquid luck, does Harry win in Slughorn's first lesson?
questions.explanation: Harry wins the Felix Felicis by brewing the best Draught of Living Death, helped by the Half-Blood Prince's notes.

questions.prompt: What is a Portkey?
questions.answer: An ordinary object enchanted to carry anyone touching it to a set place, often at a set time.
questions.explanation: A Portkey takes Harry and Cedric from the Triwizard maze to the Little Hangleton graveyard.

questions.prompt: What is Lord Voldemort's birth name?
questions.explanation: "I am Lord Voldemort" is an anagram of "Tom Marvolo Riddle", which Riddle reveals in Chamber of Secrets.

questions.prompt: What is Harry Potter's middle name?
questions.explanation: Harry is named after his father. One of Harry's own sons is named Albus Severus.
